description: Defines utility functions, a class for managing temporary random files, and related helpers for file testing within the starboard/nplb namespace.

classes.name: ScopedRandomFile
classes.description: Manages creation and deletion of a temporary random file, with methods to generate filenames, check patterns, and retrieve file info.

methods.name: GetTempDir
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory path used by ScopedRandomFile.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDataDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where static data for file tests is stored.

methods.name: GetFileTestsFilePaths
methods.description: Returns a list of file paths in the static data for file tests.

methods.name: GetFileTestsDirectoryPaths
methods.description: Returns a list of directory paths in the static data for file tests.

methods.name: GetTestFileExpectedContent
methods.description: Returns the expected content of a static data test file given its path.

methods.name: ScopedRandomFile
methods.description: Class for creating a temporary file with random content, automatically deleted when out of scope.

methods.name: MakeRandomFilename
methods.description: Generates a random filename without creating the file.

methods.name: filename
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the ScopedRandomFile instance.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the specified size of the file.

methods.name: ExpectPattern
methods.description: Checks if a buffer matches the expected pattern, used for testing.
